z-m-10-05.title: Nzira pfupi yekutsvaga perimeter inogara ichishanda here?
z-m-10-05.topic: Perimeter yezvimiro zvakagadzirwa nema grid squares, nemiganhu yenzira iri nyore
z-m-10-05.goal: Edza nemienzaniso kuti nzira iri nyore yekutsvaga perimeter yechimiro kubva pa perimeter ye rectangle inochitenderedza yakarurama muzvimiro zvipi uye yakashata muzvipi, uye utsanangure mamiriro apo inoshanda nezvimiro zvechimiro.
z-m-10-05.material:
Grid square imwe chete isquare ine mativi e1 cm. Zvimiro zviri pazasi zvakagadzirwa nekubatanidza ma grid squares divi nedivi, uye hazvina maburi mukati. Perimeter yechimiro ndiko kureba kwemutsara wose wemuganhu wekunze, uye unosanganisirawo muganhu wezvikamu zvakakombama kuenda mukati. ■ isquare yechimiro, □ isquare isina chinhu, uye mitsara inoverengwa kubva kumusoro.
Chimiro 가: mutsara 1 ■□ / mutsara 2 ■□ / mutsara 3 ■■
Chimiro 나: mutsara 1 ■■■ / mutsara 2 □■□
Chimiro 다: mutsara 1 ■□■ / mutsara 2 ■■■
Chimiro 라: mutsara 1 □■□ / mutsara 2 ■■■ / mutsara 3 □■□
Chimiro 마: mutsara 1 ■□■ / mutsara 2 ■□■ / mutsara 3 ■■■
Jiho: 'Kana ukatsvaga perimeter ye rectangle diki zvikuru inongotenderedza chimiro (yakakodzera mitsara ye grid), yakafanana ne perimeter yechimiro. Unogona kuitsvaga nekukurumidza!' Harin: 'Ini ndinoverenga mapendero e1 cm emuganhu wekunze rimwe rimwe. Zvinotora nguva, asi zvechokwadi.'
z-m-10-05.thinking.1: Kutsvaga mamiriro ainoshanda mazviri uye ma counterexamples
z-m-10-05.thinking.2: Kugadzira mimwe mienzaniso yakati wandei inokodzera mamiriro
z-m-10-05.prereq.0: Kuziva perimeter kubva pahurefu hwemutsetse wekunze wechimiro kana sikweya imwe ye grid i 1 cm (padanho regiredhi re3-4)
z-m-10-05.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvimiro zvese zvinoita kuti mutengo wawanikwa nenzira yaJiho (perimeter ye rectangle inozvivhara) uve wakafanana nemutengo wawerengwa nenzira yaHarin (perimeter chaiyo).
z-m-10-05.s.s1.hint.0: Pachimiro chimwe nechimwe, tanga wanyora nhamba yemasikweya ari muhupamhi uye nhamba yemasikweya ari muhurefu ye rectangle diki zvikuru inochikwana.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.hint.1: Pamutsetse wekunze wechimiro chimwe nechimwe, verenga mipendero ye 1 cm wega wega nedzinza: kumusoro, kurudyi, pasi, nekuruboshwe.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.r.a: Kana wakasiya chimiro 가: kuverenga mipendero mipfupi yemutsetse wekunze kunopa 10 cm, uye perimeter ye rectangle inozvivhara (masikweya 2 muhupamhi, masikweya 3 muhurefu) i 10 cm zvakare.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.r.b: Kana wakasiya chimiro 나: mutsetse wekunze i 10 cm, uye perimeter ye rectangle inozvivhara (masikweya 3 muhupamhi, masikweya 2 muhurefu) i 10 cm zvakare.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.r.c: Kana wakasarudza chimiro 다: rectangle inozvivhara i masikweya 3 muhupamhi uye masikweya 2 muhurefu, saka perimeter yayo i 10 cm, asi kana ukaverengawo madziro nepasi pechikamu chakadzikira pakati, perimeter chaiyo i 12 cm.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.r.d: Kana wakasiya chimiro 라: mutsetse wekunze i 12 cm, uye perimeter ye rectangle inozvivhara (masikweya 3 muhupamhi, masikweya 3 muhurefu) i 12 cm zvakare.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.r.e: Kana wakasarudza chimiro 마: rectangle inozvivhara i masikweya 3 muhupamhi uye masikweya 3 muhurefu, saka i 12 cm, asi chikamu chakadzikira chakadzika, saka perimeter chaiyo i 16 cm.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.explain: Perimeter chaiyo uye perimeter ye rectangle inozvivhara i 10 cm ne 10 cm pachimiro 가, 10 cm ne 10 cm pachimiro 나, 12 cm ne 10 cm pachimiro 다, 12 cm ne 12 cm pachimiro 라, uye 16 cm ne 12 cm pachimiro 마. Dzakafanana i 가, 나, ne 라. Pa 다 ne 마, dzine chikamu chakadzikira mukati, mutengo waJiho i mudiki kupfuura chaiyo.
z-m-10-05.s.s2.prompt: Fungidzira rectangle ine masero w muhupamhi uye masero h muhurefu, ine chikamu chakadzikira chehupamhi hwesero 1 uye kudzika kwemasero d chakachekwa panzvimbo imwe mumutsetse wepamusoro isiri kumagumo ose. Chikamu chakadzikira hachisvike pamuganhu wepasi, uye mitsetse 1 kana kupfuura inosara pasi pacho. Semuenzaniso, pane chimiro che (w=3, h=2, d=1) nechimiro che (w=3, h=3, d=2). Tsvaga zvimiro zvitatu zvine w, h, d dzakasiyana uye hurefu hwemutsetse wekunze (perimeter) i 18 cm.
z-m-10-05.s.s2.hint.0: Enzanisa ma perimeter chaiwo ezvimiro (w=3, h=2, d=1) ne (w=3, h=3, d=2) padivi pedivi neperimeter ye rectangle isina chikamu chakadzikira, uye utarise kuti hurefu hwekuwedzera hunoenderana sei nekudzika kwechikamu chakadzikira.
z-m-10-05.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza w, h, d uye uverenge perimeter wega; kana i hombe kupfuura 18 cm, ideredze, uye kana i diki, iwedzere, wobva wagadzirisa.
z-m-10-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Idzi i natural numbers dzinogona kugadzira chimiro.
z-m-10-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Nyora w se natural number 3 kana kupfuura, h se 2 kana kupfuura, uye d se 1 kana kupfuura.
z-m-10-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Chikamu chakadzikira chinosvika pamuganhu wepasi. Kudzika kwechikamu chakadzikira kunofanira kuva kudiki ne 1 kana kupfuura pane nhamba yemasikweya ari muhurefu.
z-m-10-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Perimeter haisi 18 cm. Enzanisa neperimeter ye rectangle isina chikamu chakadzikira uye uverenge kuti chikamu chakadzikira chinowedzera sei perimeter.
z-m-10-05.s.s2.explain: Kana ukachekera chikamu chakadzikira, perimeter i perimeter ye rectangle isina chikamu chakadzikira, 2×(w+h), pamwe nehurefu hwemadziro maviri echikamu chakadzikira, 2×d. Zviitiko zve 18 cm i (w, h, d) = (3, 4, 2), (3, 5, 1), (4, 3, 2), (4, 4, 1), (5, 3, 1), (6, 2, 1).
z-m-10-05.s.s3.prompt: Zvimiro zvinoshanda nenzira yaJihu zvinosiyana sei muchimiro nezvimiro zvisingashande? Nyora kuti chimiro chakadini chinoita kuti mutengo waJihu usiyane neperimeter chaiyo.
z-m-10-05.s.s3.hint.0: Enzanisa pamitsetse yezvimiro zvawakasarudza sezvakaenzana mubvunzo 1 nezvimiro zvausina kusarudza.
z-m-10-05.s.s3.hint.1: Pazvimiro zvausina kusarudza, tsvaga kwaunoona mitsetse isingawanikwi muperimeter ye rectangle inozvivhara.
z-m-10-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatsanangura nenzira chaiyo musiyano muchimiro pakati pezvimiro zvinoshanda (가, 나, 라) nezvimiro zvisingashande (다, 마), sa "chikamu chakadzikira chakavharwa mativi ose" here?
z-m-10-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora kuti perimeter chaiyo inosiyana sei nekuda kwemusiyano uyu here?
z-m-10-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakashandisa zita rechimiro rimwe (가 kusvika 마) mutsananguro yako here?
z-m-10-05.s.s3.model.0: Pazvimiro 가, 나, 라, uko masero ari mumutsetse achienderera pasina kupwanya, nzira yaJihu i yakarurama. Asi muchimiro se 다, apo pakati pemutsetse wepamusoro pasina chinhu uye chikamu chakadzikira chine chimiro mativi ose, madziro nepasi pechikamu chakadzikira i hurefu husiri muperimeter ye rectangle inozvivhara, saka perimeter chaiyo i refu.
z-m-10-05.s.s3.model.1: Muchimiro chine chikamu chakadzikira pakati, mutengo waJihu i mudiki kupfuura chaiyo. 가, 나, 라 hazvina chikamu chakadzikira saka mitengo yakaenzana, uye pa 다 ne 마 perimeter chaiyo i hombe nekuda kwemadziro ari mativi ose echikamu chakadzikira.
z-m-10-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Mhinduro inotsanangurwa ne 'ine chikamu chakadzikira / haina chikamu chakadzikira' i yakanakawo.
z-m-10-05.s.s3.model.2: Pa 다 ne 마, sero risina chinhu riri pakati pema ■ emutsetse wepamusoro, saka perimeter inokura kupfuura ye rectangle.

z-m-10-03.topic: Mutemo wehuwandu hwema diagonals e polygon
z-m-10-03.title: Polygon ine ma diagonals mangani?
z-m-10-03.goal: Ona kuti kufungidzira kwakaitwa kubva pa data shoma kunogadziriswa sei ne data itsva, uye batanidza huwandu hwema diagonals kubva pa vertex imwe kuhuwandu hwose hwema diagonals kutarisa kunyange chikonzero chemutemo.
z-m-10-03.material: Diagonal isegment inobatanidza ma vertices maviri e polygon asiri padivi pemumwe. Basa iri rinofunga ma polygons asina kukombama kuenda mukati chete. Quadrilateral ine mativi 4, pentagon ine mativi 5, hexagon ine mativi 6, uye heptagon ine mativi 7. Hapana pikicha inoratidzwa, saka zvidhirowe iwe pachako papepa.
z-m-10-03.thinking.0: Kufungidzira mutemo kubva pa data shoma nekuuedza
z-m-10-03.thinking.1: Kutonga kana data itsva ichichinja kana kusimbisa kufungidzira
z-m-10-03.prereq.0: Zvinoreva diagonal nemazita quadrilateral, pentagon, ne hexagon (nhanho yeGrade 4)
z-m-10-03.prereq.1: Kunyora huwandu hwemativi nehuwandu padivi pemumwe mutafura kuti uenzanise
z-m-10-03.s.s1.prompt: Data inoratidzwa rimwe panguva. Padanho rimwe nerimwe, sarudza kufungidzira kwako, uye mushure mekuona data itsva, sarudza kuchengeta kufungidzira kwako kana kukugadzirisa.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.hint.0: Kana unogona kudhirowa, tumidza ma vertices, batanidza mapoinzi maviri asiri padivi pemumwe, uye unyore zvawakaverenga mutafura.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kana data itsva ichikodzera kana kupokana nekufungidzira kwekare; kana ichikodzera, wedzera chikonzero, uye kana isingakodzeri, sarudza zvekugadzirisa.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Diagonal isegment inobatanidza ma vertices maviri asiri padivi pemumwe. Ma polygons asina kukombama kuenda mukati chete ndiwo anofungwa. Tumidza ma vertices ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ uye uadhirowe iwe pachako. Pandakadhirowa ndikaverenga, quadrilateral yaiva ne2 diagonals uye pentagon yaiva ne5 diagonals.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unofunga kuti hexagon, isati yadhirowwa, ine ma diagonals mangani?
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Vose b ne d kufunga kunonzwisisika parizvino. Nedata mbiri chete, kufungidzira kwekuti "inokwira ne3 nguva dzose" kunofanira kuedzwa.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: 10: yakawanikwa nekuwedzera nhamba mbiri dzekare, 2 ne5.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Hapana chiri mu data chinopa chikonzero chekuvimba mutemo wekuwedzera nhamba mbiri. Tarisa kana nzira imwe chete yakarurama kuna quadrilateral ne triangle zvakare.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: 8: yakakwira ne3, saka pamwe inokwira ne3 zvakare.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uku kufungidzira kwakatambanudza mutemo wakawanikwa kubva pa data mbiri. Kuti kufungidzira uku kwakarurama here kunofanira kuedzwa nekuverenga hexagon zvakananga.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: 12: hexagon ine mativi 6, saka ndi2 nguva huwandu hwemativi.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kana ukashandisa mutemo mumwe chete kuna quadrilateral (mativi 4, 2 diagonals), haukodzeri data.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Zvakaoma kuziva parizvino: ndinoda kudhirowa hexagon ndoiverenga zvakananga.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Iyi ndiyo hunhu hwekumira kufungidzira kana data iri shoma uye kuda kutarisa zvakananga.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Ndakadhirowa hexagon ndikaverenga ma diagonals, uye aiva 9. Kusvika zvino quadrilateral ine 2, pentagon ine 5, uye hexagon ine 9.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Unofunga kuti heptagon ine ma diagonals mangani?
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.after: c ndiwo mutemo wakawanikwa kubva pa data 2, 5, 9, uye d ihunhu hwekuda kutarisa mutemo iwoyo. Vose vanonzwisisika. Wekutanga "3 panguva" hausingakodzeri data ye hexagon, saka unofanira kugadziriswa.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 12: ndinofunga kuti inoramba ichikwira ne3 panguva.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Hexagon yakabuda 9, kwete 8. Tarisazve kana pfungwa yekuti inokwira ne3 panguva ichikodzera data yazvino.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Tarisa kana inowedzera kaviri pakati pe quadrilateral ne pentagon, uye pakati pe pentagon ne hexagon zvakare.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: 14: kuwedzera kuri 3, wozova 4, saka inotevera inokwira ne5.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uku kufungidzira kwakawanikwa nekutarisa kuti kuwedzera kwakachinja sei mu data 2, 5, 9.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Zvakaoma kuziva parizvino: ndinoda kudhirowa heptagon ndoiverenga zvakananga.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Iyi ndiyo hunhu hwekuita kufungidzira asi uchida kuriedza nekutarisa zvakananga.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Ndakaverenga ma diagonals anogona kudhirowwa kubva pa vertex imwe: quadrilateral ine 1, pentagon ine 2, uye hexagon ine 3. Izvi nekuti haugoni kudhirowa diagonal kuvertex pachayo nekuma vertices 2 ari padivi kumativi ose. Heptagon inogona kuva ne4 yakadhirowwa kubva pa vertex imwe neimwe. Kana ukawedzera nhamba dzakaverengwa kubva pama vertices ose, diagonal imwe neimwe inoverengwa kaviri, kamwe kubva pagumo rega rega.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Heptagon ine ma diagonals mangani dzose?
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Heptagon ine ma diagonals 14. Izvi zvakafanana ne14 yakafungidzirwa kare kubva pamutemo, uye zvino tinoziva zvakare kuti nei iri 14. Quadrilateral 4×1÷2=2, pentagon 5×2÷2=5, uye hexagon 6×3÷2=9 zvose zvakarurama zvakare.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: 28: verenga 4 pa vertex imwe neimwe ye7.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Iyo ndiyo nhamba yakaverengwa kaviri, kamwe kubva pagumo rega rega. Funga kuti ungaverenga sei imwe neimwe kamwe chete.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: 14: wedzera nhamba dzose dzakaverengwa uye uparadzanise nembiri.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Uku kufunga kwakagadzirisa kuverenga diagonal imwe chete kaviri uye kwakazvibatanidza ne14 yakafungidzirwa kare.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Data haipi chikonzero chekuwedzera. Edza nzira imwe chete kuna quadrilateral (4+1) uye utarise kana ichienderana ne2.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: 4: nhamba yaunogona kudhirowa kubva pa vertex imwe.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Siyanisa nhamba yakaverengwa kubva pa vertex imwe nehuwandu hwose hwakaverengwa kubva pama vertices ose.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.reflect: Wekutanga "unokwira ne3 panguva" wakagadziriswa ne data ye hexagon, uye 14 ye heptagon yakasimbiswa seyakafungidzirwa nemutemo uye nechikonzero. Siyanisa kuti data ipi yakachinja kufungidzira neipi yakachisimbisa.
z-m-10-03.s.s2.prompt: Kune polygon ine mativi n (isina kukombama kuenda mukati, uye n ndi natural number kubva ku3 kusvika ku12), tsvaga nyaya 3 dzakasiyana apo huwandu hwema diagonals hwakakura kupfuura huwandu hwemativi.
z-m-10-03.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora huwandu hwemativi nehuwandu hwema diagonals padivi pemumwe kune quadrilateral, pentagon, ne hexagon.
z-m-10-03.s.s2.hint.1: Pamhanyisa tafura kurudyi uye utarise kana pane ma diagonals akawanda kupfuura mativi kana pane mativi 7 nemativi 8 zvakare.
z-m-10-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Natural number kubva ku3 kusvika ku12.
z-m-10-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Nyora huwandu hwemativi se natural number kubva ku3 kusvika ku12.
z-m-10-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Huwandu hwema diagonals hwakakura kupfuura huwandu hwemativi.
z-m-10-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Huwandu hwema diagonals hahuna kukura kupfuura huwandu hwemativi. Enzanisa huwandu hwema diagonals nehwemativi padivi pemumwe mutafura kune quadrilateral, pentagon, ne hexagon.
z-m-10-03.s.s2.explain: Pentagon ine mativi 5 nema diagonals 5, zvakafanana. Kubva pa hexagon (mativi 6, ma diagonals 9) kuenda mberi, pane ma diagonals akawanda. Chero 6 kusvika ku12 yakarurama.
z-m-10-03.s.s3.prompt: Polygon isina kukombama kuenda mukati ine ma diagonals 10 anogona kudhirowwa kubva pa vertex imwe. Polygon iyi ine mativi mangani?
z-m-10-03.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora huwandu hwemativi nehuwandu hwema diagonals kubva pa vertex imwe padivi pemumwe kune quadrilateral, pentagon, ne hexagon, uye utarise musiyano.
z-m-10-03.s.s3.hint.1: Shandisa musiyano wawakawana kusarudza huwandu hwemativi kana pane ma diagonals 10, uye utarise zvakare kana hukama hwakafanana huchishanda kune quadrilateral.
z-m-10-03.s.s3.r.a: Uku kufunga kwakaona huwandu hwema diagonals kubva pa vertex imwe sehwakafanana nehwemativi. Tarisa kana nhamba mbiri dzakafanana mu quadrilateral ne pentagon.
z-m-10-03.s.s3.r.b: Iyi ndiyo nzira yekubvisa 3 kumashure kubva ku10. Tarisa nedata kana huwandu hwema diagonals kubva pa vertex imwe hunokwira kana kudzikira sezvo huwandu hwemativi huchikura.
z-m-10-03.s.s3.r.c: Uku kufunga kwakawana musiyano pakati pehuwandu hwema diagonals kubva pa vertex imwe nehwemativi ndokuhushandisa kumashure.
z-m-10-03.s.s3.r.d: Uku kufunga kwakaona musiyano pakati pehuwandu hwemativi nehwema diagonals kubva pa vertex imwe seimwe hombe. Tarisa kana wakaverenga vertex pachayo nevamwe vaviri vari padivi.
z-m-10-03.s.s3.explain: Huwandu hwema diagonals anogona kudhirowwa kubva pa vertex imwe ndi (huwandu hwemativi) − 3. Kana ari 10, polygon ine mativi 13, saka ndi 13-gon. Ipapo huwandu hwose hwema diagonals ndi 13×10÷2=65.

z-m-10-02.title: Kana zvimiro zvichisangana pamupoinzi mumwe, pachasara chikamu here kana zvichaenzana?
z-m-10-02.topic: Makona ezvimiro zvinosangana kutenderera poinzi rimwe
z-m-10-02.goal: Uchishandisa chokwadi chokuti kana makona ezvimiro akaunganidzwa kutenderera poinzi rimwe, makona anofanira kuwedzera kusvika kutenderera kumwe kwakazara (360°) kuti pasave nechikamu chakasara nokupfuura, tonga nokuenzanisa hukuru hwechikamu chakasara nekona imwe yechimiro, uye gadzira mhinduro dzakati wandei iwe pachako.
z-m-10-02.material: Kona imwe yekatatu yakaenzana, sikweya, nehegzagoni yakaenzana ndi 60°, 90°, ne 120°, zvichiteerana. Kana ukaunganidza makona ezvimiro zvakati wandei papoinzi rimwe, kana makona ose akatenderedza poinzi iroro akawedzera kusvika ku 360° (kutenderera kumwe kwakazara), anokwana chaizvo pasina chikamu chakasara kana kupfuura. Kana huwandu huri pasi pe 360°, chikamu chinosara, uye kana huri pamusoro pe 360°, zvimiro zvinopfuurana. Basa iri rinotarisa "kutenderera poinzi rimwe" chete, uye harina kufunga kana pasi rakafara rinogona kuvharwa zvachose. Hapana mufananidzo unoratidzwa.
z-m-10-02.thinking.1: Kugadzira mhinduro dzakati wandei dzinosangana nemamiriro
z-m-10-02.thinking.2: Kutsanangura kuti sei mamiriro asingagoneki asingagoneki
z-m-10-02.prereq.0: Kutenderera kumwe kwakazara kutenderera poinzi ndi 360°
z-m-10-02.prereq.1: Kona imwe yekatatu yakaenzana, sikweya, nehegzagoni yakaenzana ndi 60°, 90°, ne 120° zvichiteerana (zvakapiwa sedata)

z-m-10-01.title: Kutarisa kona pakati pemaoko eawa yawanikwa naHajun
z-m-10-01.goal: Mukugadzirisa kwakawana kona inoumbwa nemaoko maviri eawa, tsvaga uye ururamise mutsetse une kufunga kusingashandi (umo kufamba kweruoko rwemaawa kwakashaikwa), uye shandisa pfungwa imwe chete kutsvaga nguva dzine kona yakapinza iwe pachako uye utsanangure kuti sei.
z-m-10-01.material:
Pachiso cheawa, nhamba 1 kusvika 12 dzakaiswa pakaenzana. Kutenderera kumwe kwakazara ndi 360°, saka kona pakati penhamba imwe neinotevera ndi 30°. Ruoko rupfupi (ruoko rwemaawa) runofamba nekumhanya kwakagadzikana kwenzvimbo imwe yenhamba (30°) paawa, uye ruoko rurefu (ruoko rwemaminitsi) runoratidza nhamba 6 pamaminitsi 30. Kona iri pakati pemaoko maviri inoreva kona iri parutivi risipfuure 180°. Hapana mufananidzo unoratidzwa, saka fungidzira pachiso cheawa mupfungwa dzako.
Hajun akawana kona iri pakati pemaoko maviri pa 2:30 seizvi.

z-m-10-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 hauna kururama. Ruoko rwemaawa runofamba nzvimbo imwe (30°) zvakagadzikana paawa, saka pa 2:30 rwakatofamba hafu yenzvimbo (15°) pashure penhamba 2 uye ruri pakati pe 2 ne 3 chaizvo. Ipapo kubva paruoko rwemaawa kusvika panhamba 6 ndi nzvimbo 3 nehafu, ndiko kuti 3.5×30=105°. Mutsetse 1 wakarurama pamusoro pomugariro weruoko rurefu pamaminitsi 30, uye mutsetse 2 wakarurama nokuti mufananidzo we "2 o'clock chaizvo". Kuverenga pamutsetse 4 kwakarurama pachako asi kwakashandisa mugariro wakanganisa kubva mumutsetse 3, uye mutsetse 5 ndiyo mhedzisiro yeizvozvo.
